newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to buy term high speed diesel, SKO.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to buy term high speed diesel, SKO.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a term tender to buy 0.25-percent sulphur high speed diesel (HSD) and superior kerosene (SKO) for delivery between August 1997 to March 1998, industry sources said on Tuesday.
IOC wants offers for a cargo of each product per month.
IOC had earlier on Tuesday issued a tender to buy up to 1.08 million tonnes of 0.5 percent and 1.0 percent sulphur diesel for delivery over the same period.
This tender also closes July 2 and is valid until July 6.

In its last term tender for delivery between June 1997 and May 1998, IOC purchased a 30,000 tonne cargo per month of SKO from Kuwait Petroleum Company (KPC) for delivery to the west coast at $1.32 per barrel above spot Mideast quotes on a cost-and-freight basis.
It also purchased from KPC a 45,000 tonne cargo of 0.25 percent sulphur diesel each month at $2.14 per barrel over Mideast quotes for delivery to the west coast of India.
